title: I let AI live a whole life in my game

captions.intro1: Meet Ada. An AI is about to live her whole life.
captions.e41: Then Gran, who always has a lot to say.
captions.e51: Ada's first shop. Mr Ambrose sells sweets.
captions.e56: Two livs on a fizzy sweet. Worth it.
captions.e95: A year later. Gran's knees predict the weather.
captions.e99: Ada has a plan to fund the sweet habit.
captions.e113: Mrs Pell, still talking about fields.
captions.e131: She buys him one. Kind, as promised.
captions.e145: Age 7. Mum still wants her home before dark.
captions.e159: Mum says the same thing every morning.
captions.e214: Teenage Ada. Still checking in on Gran.
captions.e437: All grown up, and still visiting Gran.
captions.e1417: Grey hair now. Same kind heart.
captions.stage-child-count: Four time jumps. Family three times, friends once.
captions.stage-teen-count: The teenage years: 15 time jumps. Family wins, 10 to 5.
captions.stage-adult-count: Forty years in 60 jumps. Family wins again, 46 to 14.
